Grandma's Chicken & Rice Soup

I still remember the smell of this soup simmering on my grandmother's stove every winter Sunday. She never wrote the recipe down — it took me three tries to get it right, and I finally did, so here it is, with love, for you.

Subscribe for more recipes like this!

Serve hot with crusty bread. Leftovers keep well in the fridge for a few days.
